name: Ranalus
description: A vedalken heretic who found enlightenment in the coatl's scales rather than etherium.

description_citations.text: Alara Reborn: card flavor text (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: Ranalus says he found in the coatl's scales the enlightenment he never found in etherium.
timeline.quote: The enlightenment I never found in etherium I have found traced in the coatl's scales.

citation.text: Lorescale Coatl (Alara Reborn, 2009), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.
